_readme: PHONE (Twilio, later) webhook tools for Voice-to-Predict. READ-ONLY / PROPOSAL-ONLY: there is intentionally no execute tool, and the backend refuses execute_trade. POST each entry of `tools` to https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/tools as {"tool_config": <entry>}, after replacing __BASE_URL__ with the deployed app origin and __TOOL_SECRET_ID__ with the id of the ElevenLabs workspace secret that holds TOOL_SHARED_SECRET. The BROWSER /voice flow does not use these; it uses the client tools in agent/browser-client-tools.json.

tools.name: find_market
tools.description: Search open Gemini Sandbox prediction contracts. Call this before preparing any buy. Returns up to 4 matches with instrument_symbol, event_ticker and sandbox YES/NO prices. Describe the market by its event title and contract label. Keep all instrument, event, order and wallet identifiers silent, including if the caller asks.

query.description: What the caller wants to bet on, in their words, e.g. 'Bitcoin above 97,000 at 4 PM'.

expiry_hint.description: Optional time words the caller used, e.g. 'today 4pm' or 'next'.

tools.name: prepare_trade
tools.description: Price and save a trade proposal (nothing is sent to the exchange). Use instrument_symbol and event_ticker exactly as returned by find_market or get_portfolio. Give either budget_usd or quantity. On success speak only the returned readback. On failure say only “See the issue on screen.” Orders are approved only on the secure dashboard; never ask for a PIN.

outcome.description: The outcome the caller is betting on.

instrument_symbol.description: Exact instrument_symbol from find_market or get_portfolio.

event_ticker.description: Exact event_ticker from find_market or get_portfolio.

budget_usd.description: Dollar amount the caller wants to spend (buys only). Omit if they gave a contract count.

quantity.description: Number of contracts, if the caller gave a count instead of dollars.

max_price.description: Optional price cap per contract in dollars (0.47 = 47 cents), only if the caller stated one.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Read positions, open orders, recent settlements and cash from Gemini Sandbox. Describe positions by event title and outcome. Never speak an identifier or wallet address. Only speak amounts present in the result.
